map.如何使用提取 URL？: How do I use URL Extractor?
map.提取 URL适合哪些场景？: What scenarios is URL Extractor best for?
map.从文本批量抽链接：得到可点击/可采集的 URL 清单。: Batch-extract links from text: get a clickable / crawlable URL list.
map.资源盘点：抽页面里所有 http(s) 链接做死链与外链检查。: Inventory: pull all http(s) links from a page for dead-link and outbound checks.
map.数据准备：把散落 URL 汇总去重，导入爬虫或书签。: Data prep: gather scattered URLs, deduplicate, import to crawler or bookmarks.
map.文本含「详见 https://a.com/doc 与 http://b.cn/h: Text "see https://a.com/doc and http://b.cn/help" yields two URLs and dedupes them, ready for batch reachability probing.
map.带参数的长链接完整吗？: Are long links with parameters kept intact?
map.完整保留 query（?id=1&t=2）；但末尾标点若紧贴会被误含，建议抽取后: The query (?id=1&t=2) is fully kept; but trailing punctuation stuck to the end may be wrongly included - trim after extraction or enable the "stop at punctuation" mode.
map.相对路径（/doc/a）不以 http 开头，默认不抽；需结合基址拼接时才算完整: Relative paths (/doc/a) do not start with http and are skipped by default; they count as a full URL only when joined with a base address.
